scripts.text:
You can't proceed with the conversation because you have a large quantity of items.
Please organize your items and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多，无法继续交谈，请先整理背包再来。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Hello! I see you are an adventurer who gives your heart to traveling, uses a boat to sail across the continent, and enjoys the thrill of danger!
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
你好！看得出来，你热爱旅途，乘船横越大陆，还喜欢冒险带来的刺激！

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Do you have any {0} in your storage?
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
你的仓库里有{0}吗？

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
If you bring me a {0}, I'll exchange it to {1}. What do you think? Do you have any idea what this item is?
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
带来{0}，我就换给你{1}，怎么样？知道它有什么用吗？

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Have you ever thought about replacing your {0} to something better? For example... {1}. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
你有没有想过把{0}换成更好的东西？比如...{1}。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 这是什么？

scripts.text: I'm not interested
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
{0} is an item that prevents you from losing experience on death once within the 30 minutes duration after use.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
使用{0}后，30分钟内能免除一次死亡带来的经验值损失。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
But a lot of people are sad about the time limit, right? So I looked into it and prepared the {0}.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
不过，很多人嫌有时限，对吧？所以我研究了一下，准备了{0}。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
{0} is an item that will prevent the loss of experience on death once by just having it ^EE0000regardless of the duration^000000. Of course, after death, the {1} is consumed.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
{0}只要随身携带，就能免除一次死亡的经验值损失，^EE0000没有时限^000000。
当然，死亡后{1}就会消耗掉。

scripts.text: Why are you exchanging it?
scripts.translation: 为什么要交换它？

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Are you curious about that? I'm a merchant. Buying and selling things is my fate, whether it's related to one's life or death. Do you think I'm going to miss this opportunity to make money? I make money, and the living get a leeway from the pain of death. Isn't that a good deal?
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
好奇？我是商人，买卖就是我的本行，哪怕与生死有关也一样。
赚钱的机会，怎么能放过？我赚了钱，冒险者也少受点死亡的苦，不是两全其美？

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
The exchange rate is 5 {0} for 1 {1}. Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
兑换比例是5个{0}换1个{1}。你有什么疑问吗？

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Hm~ What do you think? Isn't it a fair trade? Do you want to always worry about time? It's a must-have for adventurers who enjoy breathtaking adventures.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
怎么样，划算吧？总不想每次都惦记时限吧？喜欢刺激冒险的人，非备上不可。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Yeah, yeah. Good decision. It's better to exchange it for a better one, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
对嘛，换个更好的，多明智！

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
I can exchange your ^0000cd5 {0} to 1 {1}.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
我可以把你的^0000cd5个{0}换成1个{1}。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
However, ^EE0000[Not for sale] {0} is not eligible for exchange^000000, so it is useless to bring it here and ask for it to be exchanged.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
不过，^EE0000[非卖品]{0}不能兑换^000000，拿来也没用哦。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Shall we exchange it now?
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
我们现在就兑换吗？

scripts.text: Exchange it please!
scripts.translation: 请兑换！

scripts.text: I don't want to exchange it.
scripts.translation: 我不想兑换

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
How many do you want to exchange? ^0000cdYou can exchange up to 10 {0} at a time^000000.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
你想兑换多少个？^0000cd一次最多可以兑换10个{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Hm? Are you not interested? This is a great product, and it's really good for someone like you. But if you don't want to protect your live, I won't force you either.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
嗯，不感兴趣？这么好的东西，很适合你啊。
不过你不想保命，我也不勉强。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Like I said, ^0000cdyou can only exchange up to 10^000000 at a time. Check the quantity again.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
就像我说的，^0000cd一次最多只能兑换10个^000000。请重新确认数量。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Um, excuse me but... you don't have enough {0}, no? It's 5 {1} for 1 {2}. Please check the quantity.
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
呃...你的{0}不够吧？得用5个{1}换1个{2}，再数数看。

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
Now, with this, I've exchanged your ^0000cd{0}^000000 for the ^EE0000{1}^000000!! That was a good deal, wasn't it? The next time you get your hands on a {2}, come see me again!
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
好了，已经把你的^0000cd{0}^000000换成^EE0000{1}^000000！！划算吧？
下次再有{2}，记得找我！

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
This is a great deal! Adventurer, it's a must-have item for people like you who ventures in dangerous places!
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
这可是个超值的好东西！冒险者，对于像你这样经常去危险地方的人来说，这是必备物品！

scripts.text:
[Heart Merchant]
If you become interested in it, be sure to come back for the exchange. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[心之商人]
如果你对它感兴趣，记得回来兑换。好吗？
